tenderSchedule.title: Providing and supplying of fire crackers for burning Ravana model during Banni mudi programme and making other arrangements on occasion of Utsava Samithi 2026 organised by Shivmogga City Corporation.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing and supplying of fire crackers for burning Ravana model during Banni mudi programme and making other arrangements on occasion of Utsava Samithi 2026 organised by Shivmogga City Corporation.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For detailed specification refer to attached detailed estimation.
Bidder has to quote rates and inclusive of all taxes for all items.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other documents as per tender document
Firm Registered Proprietor, Partnership, Public Sector or Private limited Company registration certificate
Minimum financial turnover with UDIN not less than the estimated cost of this tender,from the annual payments for any 1 year in last 5 years

Tenderer in his name should have provided at least one similar service in any state level dasara event in any one of last five financial years, certificate should be signed by Executive Engineer or equivalent authority
Tenderer in his name should have turnover in last 5 financial years period i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN number

itemList.itemName: In connection with the Shivamogga Dasara 2026 celebrations specifically the procession, the Banni ritual, and the burning of the Ravana effigy using a Rama-bana arrow the following firecrackers are to be supplied and burst Shots Color-out fireworks 500-shot 3 boxes 240-shot 10 boxes 100-shot 10 boxes 120-shot 8 boxes 60-shot 50 boxes 100-shot 5-shot 50 boxes 100-shot 50 pieces) Atom Bomb Prachanda (30-foot range 2 units) Color Single shots (60 boxes) and firecracker garlands/chains (60 packs).
